messages:
Maya: quick reserved GPU health check for this week — Meridian (prod reserved), Cobalt (reserved, low use). TL;DR: Meridian ~72% fill, periodic queue spikes; Cobalt ~29% fill, underutilized, could be churn risk.
Liam: can you drop the raw numbers?
Maya: Meridian: GPU_hours_week=1120/1560 (72%), avg_saturation=0.85, p95_latency=210ms, queue_depth_peak=18, queue_depth_median=5. Cobalt: GPU_hours_week=460/1560 (29%), avg_saturation=0.28, p95_latency=120ms, queue_depth_peak=2.
Sophia: those Meridian spikes line up with Mon 09:00-10:30 PST — any known batch jobs? :thinking_face:
Maya: customer confirmed nightly retrain moved recently from 01:00 UTC -> runs overlap with US morning because of job priority. They also started an ad-hoc tuning job Tuesday.
Trent: Notes from infra: autoscaler did 2 node adds on Meridian Wed @09:12, settled after 14m. We saw kernel queueing in the runtime logs: `RT-queue-depth: 18` and `batch_wait_ms p95 ~ 320ms`.
CapacityBot: ALERT 1773458000: Meridian queue_depth > 15 for 12m; autoscale triggered +2 GPUs.
Liam: cost delta from those bursts?
Maya: estimate extra spend this week from bursts ~ $1.8k. Without intervention projection for next invoice +$4.5k if pattern repeats.
Sophia: mitigation options: 1) spread retrain schedule 2) give retrain lower priority 3) temporary burst reservation +10% for peak window 4) enable KV prefix caching to reduce repeated cold prefixes.
Maya: customer-side tradeoffs: they want retrain to finish fast during business hours for engineering review. They asked about autoscale buffer vs. changing schedule.
Trent: I'll draft a policy: `burst_policy: {type: temporary, percent:10, window: 08:00-12:00 PT, ttl_hours: 72}` and a canary rollout. Will PR by Wed.
Maya: good. For Cobalt we should flag renewal risk — 29% fill + no recent feature usage. Recommend enable shared-burst + offer credits for ramp plan.
Liam: put renewal_risk=medium if no usage uptick next 30d. I'll mark in Salesforce.
Meridian-bot: Projection 1773459000: commit_fill=78% next cycle, renewal_risk=low->medium if bursts continue.
Sophia: ops command to throttle low-priority jobs if customer agrees:
```
redwoodctl jobs update --customer meridian --selector job=retrain --priority low --window 02:00-06:00
```
Maya: Action items: Maya -> schedule call with Meridian SRE + AE (Wed 14:00 PT); Trent -> PR for burst_policy + runbook (ETA Wed); Liam -> add renewal flag + outreach if no improvement (ETA 30d follow-up); Sophia -> add ops throttle play to runbook.
Liam: ack
Trent: I'll join the call.
Sophia: will join unless on-call handoff lands, will update calendar.
Maya: thanks all — I'll post notes + updated cost projection after call. Will drop a short runbook snippet here after Trent's PR. :thumbsup:
